// diagnostic

E2393

{import} needs an owning project context.

What

{import} needs an owning project context.

Why

Project-local imports are resolved from the nearest package or workspace graph; an isolated file has no declared project root to resolve them from.

Fix

Run jet check from the package or workspace, or replace the import with the canonical file-relative form when the dependency is local to this file.
